hierarchy.h1: font-serif text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-none text-slate-50
hierarchy.label: font-sans text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-500

rules: Use Cormorant Garamond for major dashboard titles and large metric numbers to evoke premium real-estate luxury.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all AI reasoning logs, JSON outputs, qualification scores, and timestamps.
Use Manrope for dense UI components (tables, kanban cards, forms) to ensure readability.
No generic full-screen gradients. Use deep slate backgrounds.
Primary CTA uses the Gold/Amber accent to signify value/conversion.
AI operations (Agent Calling, Reasoning) use the Electric Cyan accent.
Never use pure black or pure white. Always tint with the slate base.

surfaces: Dashboard Cards: Flat solid surface (bg-slate-900), 1px subtle border (border-slate-800), NO shadow by default.
AI Trace Panels: Retro-Futurism/Terminal look. Dark indigo base, monospace text, subtle cyan glowing border on active step.
Modals/Drawers: Crystal Glassmorphism. bg-slate-950/80, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px border-slate-800/50.
textures: Use subtle noise overlay on the main dashboard background to kill digital flatness.
Use the 'Grid Borders' pattern for analytics sections: border-collapse style with borders on right and bottom of grid items.

rules: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-col bento.
Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to stretch.

layouts.navigation: Left sidebar (w-64) for desktop, fixed. Contains Logo, Links, User Profile. Deep slate bg with subtle right border.
layouts.topbar: Sticky top bar with breadcrumbs, Global Search, and 'New Lead' Gold button. Backdrop blur enabled.
layouts.kanban_pipeline: Horizontal flex container with overflow-x-auto. Fixed width columns (w-80) for each lead state. Hide scrollbars.
layouts.lead_drawer: Right-side slide-out panel (w-[800px] max-w-[90vw]). Dual-pane internal layout: Left 40% (Lead info & Score), Right 60% (AI Transcript & Reasoning Trace).

rules: Hover States: Subtle lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and border color change.
Kanban Drag: Use framer-motion layout animations for reordering.
AI Trace Panel: Progressive disclosure. When a reasoning step expands, animate height using framer-motion AnimatePresence.
AI Calling State: Add a subtle pulsing cyan dot next to leads currently in 'CALLING' or 'IN_CONVERSATION' state.
Text Contrast: Ensure all secondary text (slate-400) passes APCA against slate-900 background.
Focus States: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-400 focus:outline-none.
Test IDs: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid="lead-card-123", data-testid="kanban-column-hot").

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for a high-end, duotone/technical look perfect for ops dashboards.
media.charts: Use Shadcn charts (Recharts under the hood). Apply custom colors from the status palette.

login_background.description: Stylish modern white house exterior with palm trees. Use as a blurred or dark-overlay background for the public Lead Capture / Login page.

agent_avatar_1.description: Elegant studio portrait. Use as placeholder for Real-Estate Broker user profile.

lead_avatar_1.description: Confident business professional. Use as placeholder for Lead avatars in Kanban cards.

component_name.LeadCard: Dense tactical card showing score, name, budget.
component_name.AITracePanel: Timeline UI for V2 LangGraph supervisor reasoning.

3d_libraries.decision: Not required for core dashboard functionality. Use Framer Motion for 2D micro-interactions. Consider Visx or D3 for the Funnel Chart if complex, otherwise stick to Recharts/Shadcn.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install necessary font dependencies via Google Fonts (Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, IBM Plex Mono) in index.css.
Use standard HTML 5 semantics and avoid deep div soup.
Implement the Kanban board using flex/grid; drag-and-drop can be mocked with simple state updates or use a lightweight dnd library if requested.
The V2 LangGraph supervisor trace MUST look like a technical timeline: monospace fonts, distinct tool-call vs thought visual states, collapsible JSON bodies.
Use data-testid on every clickable element.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do not text-align: center the main App container. Keep text left-aligned for readability.
Use 2-3x more padding than usual (e.g., p-6 or p-8 inside panels).
Never use pure #000 or #FFF; tint with slate.
Avoid AI slop: no generic centered layouts, no standard blue gradients, no robot emojis. Use professional Phosphor icons.
Prioritize Shadcn components but customize their tailwind classes heavily to match the Tactical Luxury theme.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Progressive Disclosure: In the AI Trace panel, show the high-level steps (e.g., 'Analyzing Budget', 'Booking Calendar') and hide the raw JSON/tool-calls behind an expand toggle.
North Star Metric: Place the most critical KPI (e.g., 'Total Hot Leads' or 'Pipeline Value') in the top-left of the analytics view.
Optical Alignment: Ensure icons inside Kanban cards perfectly align with the text baselines.
Visual Hierarchy: Use font weights and mono-spacing to separate data (numbers/scores) from labels.
Empty States: If a Kanban column is empty, show a dashed-border drop zone with a subtle mono label, not just blank space.
